Once upon a time, there was a place where every paw, every feather, and every little tail received attention, care, and love. A special place where you don't just come to shop, but to enjoy an experience filled with passion and dedication: Arcaplanet – Animal World.
As soon as you step inside, you immediately sense that the animals here aren't just customers... they're family. The shelves are neatly arranged, packed with quality products, designed for every need: from food to care, from play to wellness. Every detail is carefully considered, because behind this world lies a heart that beats strongly for our four-legged friends.
And then there's him, the fantastic manager Aldo. A presence that truly makes the difference. Professional, helpful, always ready to listen and offer advice with expertise and kindness. Aldo doesn't just manage the store: he leads it with passion, creating a welcoming environment where you immediately feel at ease. It's clear he loves his job and puts his heart into everything he does.
Thanks to his attentiveness and his ability to enthusiastically coordinate the team, every visit is pleasant, simple, and reassuring. You know you can count on sincere advice and attentive service, filled with smiles and genuine helpfulness.
Arcaplanet – Mondo Animale is more than just a store: it's a small kingdom dedicated to the well-being of our furry friends. And with a director like Aldo, this kingdom shines even brighter. A place where expertise and love for animals meet... and you can feel it, in every corner. 🐾✨

I bought kitten sachets for the new arrival. The promo includes 50% off the first purchase, but they weren't able to activate it.
A huge selection of products, thanks a lot
The shop is a bit stuffy. When I went there, there were only two employees.

This store is undoubtedly well-stocked and offers a wide selection of pet products, which I greatly appreciate. However, my most recent experience was ruined by a young employee whose behavior struck me as unprofessional and, more seriously, dishonest. Only after I got home and checked my receipt did I notice that for two products I had purchased individually, she had charged me for three and two items, respectively. This is outright theft and completely undermines the trust a customer should have in a store. I sincerely hope Arcaplanet takes serious action. Rude customer service is already a problem, but dishonesty is unacceptable.
